rule: A decoded MMExplorer textblock is reusable source content, not a globally unique executable quest-stage instance. Runtime script identity must include quest, NPC, root textblock, stage textblock, and stage index.
assumptions: The source textblock body remains immutable when reused; execution context supplies quest and NPC ownership.
fallback: Reject ambiguous legacy context-free script IDs rather than dispatching an arbitrary matching stage.
tests: all quest and trigger script references resolve
no runtime relationship retains script.quest_textblock.* IDs
save_or_world_state_impact: none; generated identity and dispatch-link correction only
